minor.issue: serve_file() awaits get_object() without try/except; when the Emergent object store transiently returns 503 the raw httpx.HTTPStatusError escapes and the request 500s (multiple 'Exception in ASGI application' tracebacks in backend.err.log during /brands load). Brand logos/product images then break for that request. Wrap in try/except and return 502/404 with a message (or serve a placeholder).

Response returns both legacy 'image' and new 'logo' keys with the same value — drop 'image' to avoid two sources of truth. Also imports any URL that resolves; a very large remote file has no explicit size cap (the /admin/upload path caps at 6MB).

Soft delete only (active:false). 28 hidden 'TEST_*' products had accumulated from earlier iterations, inflating Admin → Products count to 95 vs 67 public and causing seed_brands() to keep re-importing junk brands ('test','test-upload','testbrand'). I hard-removed the TEST_ products and those 3 junk brands; DB is now 67 products / 35 brands. Consider an admin hard-delete or at least excluding inactive products from brand seeding.

integration_issues.flow: Brand logo import (paste URL → Update Brand)
integration_issues.issue: Not a failure, but the two chained requests (import ~6s + PUT) take 7-10s with no busy indicator on the row beyond the small spinner in the button and no optimistic feedback; a tester/user can think it failed. Consider a clearer 'Importing logo…' state.

issues: Brand value is rendered through titleCase(p.brandName) in /app/frontend/src/seo/config.js, so an all-caps displayName is shown as 'Raz' instead of 'RAZ' (multi-word names like 'Raz Vapes'/'Muha Meds' render correctly). If displayName is meant to be authoritative everywhere, drop titleCase for the brand row/JSON-LD.
Sidebar label is 'Brand Logos' while the page heading is 'Brands' — inconsistent naming for the same route (/admin/brands).

action_items: IMPORTANT — brand counts changed: the DB now has 35 brands (all with >=1 product) and 6 logos, because the junk hidden brands 'test','test-upload','testbrand' and 28 leftover hidden TEST_ products were removed. Any code/docs/tests asserting '38 brands' (incl. Admin → Brands summary expectation) should now expect 35. seed_brands() was verified idempotent across a backend restart (imported 0, logos + displayNames preserved).
Add try/except around get_object() in GET /api/files/{path} so object-store 503s do not surface as 500s.

Legacy test files are stale AND mutate live data: tests/test_delivery_area_brands.py::TestBrandLogos wiped raz's logo and deleted a brand (old {slug,name,image} contract), tests/test_image_migration.py::TestBrands still expects 6-7 brand records, tests/test_catalog_brands.py expects 114 sitemap URLs and pre-migration image URLs, and tests/test_puff2door_full.py / test_payments_content.py / test_payments_mock.py / test_sitemap_urlonly.py use out-of-zone addresses (NY/Miami) that the delivery-zone rule now rejects → 35 stale failures. Please update or delete them; I restored raz's logo and re-deleted the products they created.
Optional: drop titleCase() on the PDP brand row so displayName casing is preserved; rename the sidebar 'Brand Logos' → 'Brands'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1824 lines — split into routers (catalog/brands/admin/orders/payments/seo) for maintainability.
GET /api/files/{path}: unguarded await get_object(path) → unhandled httpx.HTTPStatusError → 500 (only real bug found).
seed_brands() derives brands from ALL products including inactive/hidden ones, so soft-deleted test products keep resurrecting junk brands; filter on {'active': True} or on non-TEST names.
admin_update_brand() correctly never touches slug and fans displayName out to products.brandName; brand cache invalidation (invalidate_brands) is called on every mutation — verified end-to-end.
brand_out() excludes _id and all brand endpoints returned clean JSON (verified via assertions).

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15 new brand-management tests; 35 pre-existing failures are stale legacy tests, not regressions)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand Management is fully verified. Current DB baseline: 67 active products, 35 brands (== 35 product brand slugs), 6 with logos (apex, geek-bar, mellow-fellow, modus, raz, red-devil), sitemap 115 URLs incl. 35 /brand/ URLs. Use /app/backend/tests/test_brand_management.py as the brand regression suite (run with `python -m pytest tests/test_brand_management.py -p xdist -n 0`; pytest.ini requires xdist). DO NOT run tests/test_delivery_area_brands.py or tests/test_image_migration.py unmodified — they use the removed {slug,name,image} brand contract and destroy real brand logos. Playwright notes: header 'Brands' is an <a href="/brands">, not a button (hover it to open the dropdown); admin login uses data-testid login-email/login-password/login-submit; the admin product edit button is data-testid=admin-edit-<id>; brand logo import takes 7-10s so wait >=8s after clicking brand-save-<slug>.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect in Brand Management. The two apparent failures during testing were: (1) my first logo-save assertion failed only because the import+save round trip takes ~9s (>my 5s wait) — the logo was in fact persisted; (2) GET /api/files/{path} 500s are caused by serve_file() not handling httpx errors when the Emergent object store answers 503 (transient upstream). Separately, hidden TEST_ products left behind by earlier iterations' soft deletes were the reason the brands collection contained 3 product-less junk brands (38 instead of 35): seed_brands() derives brands from all products regardless of active flag.
